indications_and_usage: Uses clears acne blemishes and allows skin to heal helps prevent new acne blemishes from forming
when_using: When using this product skin irritation and dryness is more likely to occur if you use another topical acne medication at the same time. if irritation occurs, only use one topical acne medication at a time.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions use twice daily shake well, wet face, then work product into a lather massage onto face avoiding the eyes rinse well
